posts.hook: Bone can change after teeth are gone.
posts.body: A denture does not replace the root, so the jaw under it can change and the fit can loosen. An implant sits in the bone. Whether you have enough bone is a scan question, not a guess. No percentage belongs in this post.
posts.spoken: A denture does not replace the root, so the jaw under it can change and the fit can loosen. An implant sits in the bone. Whether you have enough bone is a scan question, not a guess. No percentage belongs in this post.
posts.grounding: Do not repeat the unsourced 50 percent grafting claim from the Gemini list.

posts.hook: Snap-on teeth come out. All-on-4 stays fixed.
posts.body: Snap-on dentures clip to implants and you remove them to clean. All-on-4 is a fixed bridge. Both are made here. The consultation sorts out which one the bone and the daily routine can support.
posts.spoken: Snap-on dentures clip to implants and you remove them to clean. All-on-4 is a fixed bridge. Both are made here. The consultation sorts out which one the bone and the daily routine can support.
posts.grounding: Snap-on and All-on-4 service pages.

posts.hook: CDCP covers some dentures, not most implants.
posts.body: The Canadian Dental Care Plan can cover dentures and overdentures, with preauthorization. It does not cover most implant treatment. The team bills CDCP and other plans directly. A quote still waits for the consultation.
posts.spoken: The Canadian Dental Care Plan can cover dentures and overdentures, with preauthorization. It does not cover most implant treatment. The team bills CDCP and other plans directly. A quote still waits for the consultation.

posts.hook: Upper and lower arches are planned apart.
posts.body: The upper jaw sometimes needs more bone help, including a sinus lift when the scan shows it. The lower jaw has its own shape. Each arch gets its own plan.
posts.spoken: The upper jaw sometimes needs more bone help, including a sinus lift when the scan shows it. The lower jaw has its own shape. Each arch gets its own plan.
posts.grounding: Upper-jaw and lower-jaw service pages. Do not claim every case needs a sinus lift.

posts.hook: Pain is the question. Here is the honest shape of it.
posts.body: Implant surgery is done with anesthesia, and sedation is available. Afterwards people have swelling and soreness that eases over days, not a script from an ad. Your surgeon gives the instructions. This post does not list doses.
posts.spoken: Implant surgery is done with anesthesia, and sedation is available. Afterwards people have swelling and soreness that eases over days, not a script from an ad. Your surgeon gives the instructions. This post does not list doses.
posts.grounding: No dosing. Anxiety cluster. Do not promise a painless procedure.

posts.hook: A healing abutment is a second, smaller visit.
posts.body: After the implant is in the bone, a healing cap shapes the gum for the tooth that follows. It is a step, not the whole treatment. Timing depends on how the bone is healing.
onScreen: A step, not the whole visit
posts.spoken: After the implant is in the bone, a healing cap shapes the gum for the tooth that follows. It is a step, not the whole treatment. Timing depends on how the bone is healing.

posts.hook: How to clean a fixed bridge without folklore.
posts.body: Brush it. Clean under the bridge the way the hygienist shows you, often with floss threaders or a water flosser if they say it is appropriate. Skip the homemade recipes. The aftercare visit is where the routine is set.
posts.spoken: Brush it. Clean under the bridge the way the hygienist shows you, often with floss threaders or a water flosser if they say it is appropriate. Skip the homemade recipes. The aftercare visit is where the routine is set.
posts.grounding: Aftercare education. No product ranking and no unsourced best-toothpaste claim.

posts.hook: If a tooth has been gone for years, ask anyway.
posts.body: Bone changes after an extraction, and some people need a graft or a different design. Years later is not an automatic no. The quiz is about candidacy in general. This post is about the long gap, and the scan is the answer.
onScreen: Years later is not a no
posts.spoken: Bone changes after an extraction, and some people need a graft or a different design. Years later is not an automatic no. The quiz is about candidacy in general. This post is about the long gap, and the scan is the answer.
posts.grounding: Do not target the quiz's 'am I a candidate' query. Point at bone and time.

posts.hook: What to eat in the first weeks is mostly soft.
posts.body: Soups, eggs, yogurt, and tender fish while the implants settle. The team writes the food list for your case. A steak is not the day-one story, whatever an ad once promised.
